Consider a block of mass $m$ on an inclined plane with inclination angle $\theta$:

1. Gravity acts vertically downward ($mg$).
2. The normal force acts perpendicular to the incline surface ($N = mg\cos\theta$).
3. The parallel component of gravity acts down the plane ($mg\sin\theta$).
4. Friction acts up the incline opposing impending motion.
